_comment: Grounded generation fixtures. chapter_map_node_ids are pinned stable_node_ids (SECTION nodes) from the seeded chapter map, frozen so a run resolves identically regardless of re-imports; node_selector documents how they were chosen and stays as the runtime fallback for fixtures that leave chapter_map_node_ids empty.

jesc110 is 'The Human Eye and the Colourful World' (chapter 10), not light-reflection-and-refraction (chapter 9, jesc109) — no jesc109 canonical artifact is committed yet, so light-reflection-and-refraction cannot be seeded/pinned until that source is sourced and extracted separately.
